categories.main_business_segments: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical manufacturing sector focusing on potassium chloride (KCl) and lithium carbonate products. The company also engages in trade of chemical fertilizers and chemicals, as well as other businesses including hotel management, retail, and logistics services. Its operations are organized into four reportable segments: potassium products, lithium products, trade, and others.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced salt lake resource extraction technologies, including adsorption and membrane separation for lithium extraction from brine with high magnesium-lithium ratios. It has mastered multiple potassium chloride production technologies such as reverse flotation, cold crystallization, and vacuum crystallization. The firm continuously innovates in refining processes and has patented several methods for potassium chloride and lithium carbonate production, ensuring high product quality and resource utilization efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are agricultural producers requiring potassium fertilizers and lithium products for battery manufacturing and energy storage. The potassium products mainly serve domestic agricultural markets, while lithium products cater to the growing new energy vehicle and energy storage sectors. The company also serves chemical fertilizer distributors and industrial clients domestically, with limited export sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Qinghai Province, particularly in the Qaidam Basin and Chaerhan Salt Lake area. It has subsidiaries and investments in other Chinese provinces and limited overseas operations including subsidiaries in Mauritius and Congo for mining investments. The domestic market accounts for the vast majority of its revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the extraction and processing of salt lake minerals into potassium and lithium chemical products. It controls mining rights and raw material extraction, as well as refining and manufacturing of finished chemical fertilizers and lithium salts, supplying downstream agricultural and battery manufacturing industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in salt lake resource extraction and chemical processing, aiming to improve resource recovery rates and reduce production costs. It invests in R&D for advanced lithium extraction technologies, potassium fertilizer production optimization, and development of high-value-added products like battery-grade lithium salts. The firm also focuses on green and sustainable production methods, digital transformation, and expanding its global resource footprint.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of potassium chloride and lithium carbonate products. The company also earns income from chemical fertilizer trade, industrial salt, and other chemical products. Additional revenue streams include hotel and retail operations, as well as investment income from subsidiaries and joint ventures. The business model is product sales-based with some service and investment income components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer of potassium fertilizers and lithium products, holding approximately 35% of the domestic potassium chloride market and about 8% of the national lithium carbonate production capacity. It competes with other major Chinese potassium producers like Zangge Mining and Guotou Luokai, and lithium producers in China and globally. Its strategic resource base and technological capabilities position it as a key player in the salt lake chemical industry with growing international influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 15.13 billion, a decrease of nearly 30% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 4.66 billion, down 41%. Total assets stood at RMB 45.78 billion with net assets of RMB 36.57 billion, reflecting steady scale and solid financial health. Despite market price fluctuations, the company maintains full capacity utilization in potassium and lithium production and is investing heavily in expansion projects, indicating a focus on long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry leverages its unique access to vast and high-quality salt lake mineral resources, advanced proprietary extraction and processing technologies, and integrated industry chain capabilities to offer stable, high-purity potassium and lithium products. Its technological leadership in salt lake brine processing and cost-efficient production methods provide competitive advantages. The company emphasizes sustainable and green production, resource efficiency, and product quality to meet the evolving needs of agriculture and new energy sectors, positioning itself as a reliable supplier and innovation leader.
